summary: Light window-anchored glass chrome needs an opt-in painted silhouette
expected: The existing data-neoverse-glass-edge-stroke opt-in supplies a fine light-theme perimeter when backdrop refraction cannot establish the edge, without changing the dark mapping or ordinary glass surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Explicit light and system-light provide a nontransparent fine perimeter through the existing painted-stroke token.
The dark stroke mapping and renderer, blur, opacity, scheduling and ordinary non-opted-in surfaces are unchanged.
XCA Portal light header retains a visible bottom edge with the CSS fallback; rendered edge pixels change without changing interior pixels.
Synchronize local consumer dependencies and pass the affected XCA header, theme, transition and baseline regressions without starting its development server on port 4100.

consumers.scenario: The light navbar is anchored to the window and loses its bottom glass highlight while the dark navbar remains correct.

resolution: Superseded by consumer requirement: a fixed white outline is not acceptable; the window edge must brighten the actual backdrop instead.
